question: What was the theme of the 2024 International Conference of NGOs organised by UNESCO?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Building Capacity for Action**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The theme of the 2024 International Conference of NGOs organized by UNESCO was **Building Capacity for Action**.
 
• This conference aimed to promote partnerships and strengthen the capacity of NGOs to address global challenges effectively.
 
• NGOs from diverse sectors were invited to collaborate on projects aligned with UNESCO's priorities, including education, science, culture, and communication.
 
• The conference emphasized fostering innovation and empowering NGOs to contribute to sustainable development goals (SDGs).
 
• It provided a platform for knowledge sharing, networking, and creating joint strategies to tackle pressing issues globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO:**

 
 
• United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations established in 1945.
 
• It focuses on promoting international collaboration in education, science, culture, and communication.
 
 
 
• **NGOs:**
 
 
• Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) are independent organizations focused on addressing social, environmental, and global issues.
 
• They play a crucial role in advocacy, humanitarian aid, and promoting sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• SDGs are a set of 17 global goals adopted by the United Nations in 2015 to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure prosperity for all.
 
• They include targets like quality education, gender equality, climate action, and affordable clean energy.
 
 
 
• **Capacity Building:**
 
 
• Capacity building refers to the process of developing and strengthening the skills, resources, and capabilities of organizations or individuals.
 
• It is essential for NGOs to tackle complex issues and implement effective programs on a global scale.
